provenance_status.classification: post-outcome extension using a genuinely pre-outcome predictor; not a fully outcome-blind new paper

biological_motivation.primary: Snow-free terrestrial breeding space is constrained by geomorphology. Palmer studies show that topography interacts with wind and precipitation to structure snow accumulation and Adélie breeding phenology/colony persistence.
biological_motivation.life_history_contrast: Adélie penguins show strong nest-site fidelity and early-season exposure to snow conditions, whereas gentoo penguins show greater flexibility in breeding phenology and nest-site relocation. Therefore a static terrain context is predicted to be more strongly associated with demographic coupling in Adélie than in gentoo.
literature: Cimino et al. 2019 Ecology and Evolution, doi:10.1002/ece3.5481
Hinke et al. 2012 Marine Ecology Progress Series 454:91-104, doi:10.3354/meps09633
Trivelpiece et al. comparative Adélie/Chinstrap breeding biology at Signy Island (Adélie breeding approximately one month earlier)
Juárez et al. 2013 Polar Research 32:18448, doi:10.3402/polar.v32i0.18448

terrain_predictor.transform: T = z_all_122_sites(log1p(relief_m)); one global site-level standardization shared across species
terrain_predictor.ecological_meaning: local topographic relief / terrain-option context, not direct snow exposure, slope, aspect or occupied nest microhabitat

demographic_frame.reason_for_107_units: Terrain has complete coverage and is analyzed independently of the four AEI breeding-option missing sites; no breeding-option completeness filter is applied.
demographic_frame.observation_calibration: inherit frozen Paper 2 observation model and species-wide forcing estimator unchanged

spatial_adjustment.identification: inherit V3 block-intercept and residual-loading constraints
spatial_adjustment.implementation: Use a dedicated one-predictor terrain solver with exactly one gamma_T column; inherit V3 forcing estimation, block intercepts, within-block centering, residual-loading constraints, observation calibration and process-SD profiling unchanged. Do not emulate this by adding zero H/AH columns.

pre_real_terrain_recovery_gate.failure_rule: If any species fails, stop terrain inference; do not relax thresholds.
pre_real_terrain_recovery_gate.implementation: Synthetic datasets use the frozen real observation schedule and a one-predictor loading truth. Recovery is evaluated with the exact dedicated terrain solver used for the real fit.

primary_hypothesis.name: life-history-specific terrain association
primary_hypothesis.meaning: The association between topographic relief and loading on shared species-wide forcing is more negative in Adélie than gentoo.
primary_hypothesis.important_boundary: A negative contrast is a species-difference result; it does not itself prove terrain buffering or a snow mechanism.

secondary_predictions.species_specific: For each species, test gamma_T < 0 with block-preserving permutations and Holm-adjust the three one-sided p-values.
secondary_predictions.chinstrap: Report whether gamma_T_CHPE lies between ADPE and GEPE as a descriptive life-history ordering; no separate confirmatory rank p-value.
secondary_predictions.absolute_interpretation: Only a negative species-specific gamma_T supported after Holm may be described as evidence that greater relief is associated with weaker coupling to shared forcing in that species.

permutation_inference.scheme: Within each species and frozen trait-adjustment block, permute the global-standardized terrain T values across site-species units; preserve outcomes, observation records, forcing schedule and block membership.
permutation_inference.primary_p: one-sided lower-tail plus-one p for Delta_AG
permutation_inference.species_p: one-sided lower-tail plus-one p for gamma_T, followed by Holm correction

terrain_scale: 1 km relief using the identically defined pre-existing atlas field
5 km relief using the identically defined pre-existing atlas field
sensitivities.terrain_metric: 2 km elevation SD is sensitivity-only because it is r=0.99067 with 2 km relief
sensitivities.role: sensitivities cannot replace the frozen 2 km relief primary result

decision_rule.adelie_terrain_buffering_supported: ADPE gamma_T < 0 and ADPE Holm p <= 0.05
decision_rule.if_nonconfirmatory: retain terrain as a documented life-history-motivated negative result; do not search slope/aspect/snow products in this paper

interpretation_boundaries: REMA relief is potential topographic context, not occupied nesting habitat.
Relief does not encode aspect, prevailing-wind exposure, snow depth or melt timing.
Species ranges and geography differ, so frozen within-block centering is mandatory.
Do not infer that terrain causes demographic resilience from a static association.
Do not introduce new terrain metrics after opening gamma_T except the prespecified 1 km, 5 km and elevation-SD sensitivities.
Do not use Palmer-only snow results as if they directly establish a continent-wide Pygoscelis mechanism.
